We evaluate our method on long-context summarization tasks: QMSum, GovReport and Novel Summarization ... We also evaluate on the HTML to TSV task ... and on a new synthetic task Chain-of-key that requires long-form generation.

We evaluate our methods on three sets of downstream tasks which require the model to generate long-form outputs (more than 100 tokens) given long-form inputs (more than 10k tokens). (1) long-context summarization tasks: QMSum, GovReport and Novel Summarization and (2) HTML to TSV task from LongProc benchmark.
outputs: Generated text sequences for summarization, HTML to TSV conversion, and chain-of-key generation.
